notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
 
Here’s what we’ve done lately:
-Fixed some bugs on levels 2 and 4
- Fixed the bug with dissapearing map on level 2
-Fixed the bug with life bars which weren’t looking at the camera
-Added button bubble at the character window 
-Added the whole cutscene skip by holding the button
-Fixed the bug with repeating phrases
-Dialogue and Info windows don’t overlay one another
-Crystals don’t drop from bosses on bonus levels anymore
-Fixed the bugs with cutscenes on level 3 where the Devilkin runs towards the player
-Fixed the clumsy jump
-Fixed the bug with freezing when saving game

notes.title: Update 6: Chinese language
notes.content:
Hello, dear pumpkins!
We’ve been working on catching minor bugs in the game. We’ve also released two localizations of Halloween Mysteries — German and Chinese during the January. 
Feel free to give us your feedback, it’s really important to us!

notes.title: Update 5: German localization
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
We've finally made the German localization of Halloween Mysteries! (subs only)
And we are now preparing the Chinese localization too! It will be released on Chinese New Year's day — Jan 28.
